comparisons.name: mail-details-light
comparisons.description: "Details" in the header of Mail's message, Aqua. The crop is one word, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms, and Mail draws it in a brighter blue than the link colour.

comparisons.name: mail-details-light-box
comparisons.description: As mail-details-light with the word masked: the button draws no bezel, border or fill around its title.

comparisons.name: mail-details-dark
comparisons.description: "Details" in the header of Mail's message, Dark Aqua. The crop is one word, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: mail-details-dark-box
comparisons.description: As mail-details-dark with the word masked.

comparisons.name: focus-light
comparisons.description: The focus ring around the title after Tab, Aqua. No screenshot shows it.

pixels.note: the ring left of the title: --mac-focus-ring-color, rgb(24 106 246 / 0.5), over the example's #ffffff (computed from the tokens; inferred state)
outside the ring, which is --mac-focus-ring-width (3 pt) wide: the example's background

comparisons.name: focus-dark
comparisons.description: The focus ring around the title after Tab, Dark Aqua. No screenshot shows it.

pixels.note: the ring left of the title: --mac-focus-ring-color, rgb(43 168 255 / 0.5), over the example's #1e1f21 (computed from the tokens; inferred state)
outside the ring: the example's background

comparisons.name: no-focus-ring-inactive-light
comparisons.description: After Tab in a window that is not key the button shows no focus ring, Aqua.

pixels.note: where the ring is in a key window: the example's background (CONTRIBUTING, Window state; inferred)

comparisons.name: focus-forced-colors
comparisons.description: The focus ring after Tab in forced-colours mode, in the key window: a 2 pt CanvasText outline, 1 pt outside the button.

pixels.note: the outline left of the button, which starts at 12 pt: CanvasText

comparisons.name: no-focus-ring-inactive-forced-colors
comparisons.description: After Tab in a window that is not key the button shows no focus ring in forced-colours mode either.

pixels.note: where the outline is in a key window: Canvas (CONTRIBUTING, Window state)

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: Under the pointer's press the button looks as it does at rest, Aqua: no bezel or fill, and its ink keeps its colour.

pixels.note: the button's top-left corner, above the capitals: the example's background, as a borderless button has no fill (inferred state)
the square drawn in the button's ink: --mac-color-link, unchanged by the press, as in Mail's and Home's buttons, which have no pressed look

comparisons.name: pressed-dark
comparisons.description: Under the pointer's press the button looks as it does at rest, Dark Aqua: no bezel or fill, and its ink keeps its colour.

pixels.note: the button's top-left corner, above the capitals: the example's background (inferred state)
the square drawn in the button's ink: --mac-color-link, unchanged by the press
